{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0
valid_baseline = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the mean of valid baseline values
mean_baseline = valid_baseline.mean()

# Print the mean and number of valid patients
mean_baseline, len(valid_baseline)"}
